newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai Feb exports shrank 5 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Thai Feb exports shrank 5 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Thailand's exports in February 1997 contracted by five percent year-on-year, said deputy finance minister Thawatwongse Na Chiang Mai on Wednesday.
He attributed the negative export trend to the strengthening of the Thai baht against the yen and the German mark, but did not give any further details.
"The Bank of Thailand had expressed concern about the sluggish exports. The bank will find some measures to solve the problem," he told reporters.
Thawatwongse was speaking after a monthly meeting with the central bank's senior officials to review the country's economic condition in February and in the first quarter.
The central bank is due to announce monthly key economic indicators on Thursday.
